verdict.rationale: Instinct is an autonomous personal agent, so plugging in MCP servers is a fair question for it. But nothing in the evidence shows it acting as an MCP client. Its integrations are first-party connections (Google Workspace, messaging, device access, credential sign-ins), and the probe notes that the homepage and terms mention no MCP or developer surface. These built-in connectors are adjacent features and earn no credit toward user-pluggable MCP servers.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
